items.examples: [{"chinese":"美美最大的夢想是，將來能有一棟又漂亮又舒服的大房子。","pinyin":"Měiměi zuìdà de mèngxiǎng shì, jiānglái néng yǒu yī dòng yòu piàoliang yòu shūfu de dà fángzi.","english":"Meimei's biggest dream is that in the future she can have a big house that is both beautiful and comfortable."}]
[{"chinese":"晚安！希望你有個好夢。","pinyin":"Wǎn'ān! Xīwàng nǐ yǒu ge hǎo mèng.","english":"Good night! I hope you have a good dream."}]

[{"chinese":"那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。","pinyin":"Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.","english":"Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform."}]

[{"chinese":"這部戲不但明星演得好，劇本也寫得不錯，所以票賣得非常好。","pinyin":"Zhè bù xì bùdàn míngxīng yǎn de hǎo, jùběn yě xiě de bùcuò, suǒyǐ piào mài de fēicháng hǎo.","english":"Not only do the stars act well in this play, but the script is also written quite well, so the tickets sell very well."}]

[{"chinese":"大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。","pinyin":"Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.","english":"In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work."}]

[{"chinese":"經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！","pinyin":"Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!","english":"The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!"}]

[{"chinese":"那個明星很會演戲，演了幾年戲就開始當導演，沒想到第一部戲就成功了。","pinyin":"Nàge míngxīng hěn huì yǎnxì, yǎn le jǐ nián xì jiù kāishǐ dāng dǎoyǎn, méi xiǎngdào dì yī bù xì jiù chénggōng le.","english":"That star is very good at acting; after acting for a few years, he started being a director. Unexpectedly, his first film was a success."}]

[{"chinese":"黃先生這幾天一直發燒，腦子很不清楚，恐怕沒辦法寫劇本。","pinyin":"Huáng xiānsheng zhè jǐ tiān yīzhí fāshāo, nǎozi hěn bù qīngchu, kǒngpà méi bànfǎ xiě jùběn.","english":"Mr. Huang has had a fever for the past few days, his brain is very unclear, and I'm afraid he won't be able to write the script."}]

[{"chinese":"小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.","english":"Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true."}]

[{"chinese":"哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！","pinyin":"Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!","english":"As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!"}]

[{"chinese":"小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.","english":"Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week."}]

items.meaning: to grow, to develop, to enhance

items.examples: [{"chinese":"我妹妹不但長得漂亮，身高也夠高，十六歲就有人找她演戲了。","pinyin":"Wǒ mèimei bùdàn zhǎng de piàoliang, shēngāo yě gòu gāo, shíliù suì jiù yǒu rén zhǎo tā yǎnxì le.","english":"My younger sister is not only pretty, but also tall enough; by the time she was sixteen, someone had already asked her to act."}]

[{"chinese":"那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。","pinyin":"Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.","english":"That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try."}]

[{"chinese":"出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。","pinyin":"Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.","english":"Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile."}]

[{"chinese":"東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。","pinyin":"Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.","english":"Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval."}]

[{"chinese":"這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。","pinyin":"Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.","english":"Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try."}]

[{"chinese":"聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？","pinyin":"Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?","english":"I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?"}]

items.meaning: to leave something for someone; to keep

items.examples: [{"chinese":"A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。","pinyin":"A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.","english":"A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now."}]

[{"chinese":"孔先生學法律，不但是為了當好律師，也是為了保護家人。","pinyin":"Kǒng xiānsheng xué fǎlǜ, bùdàn shì wèile dāng hǎo lǜshī, yě shì wèile bǎohù jiārén.","english":"Mr. Kong studies law not only to become a good lawyer but also to protect his family."}]

[{"chinese":"A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。","pinyin":"A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.","english":"A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it."}]

[{"chinese":"我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。","pinyin":"Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.","english":"My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately."}]

[{"chinese":"今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。","pinyin":"Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.","english":"During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good."}]

items.meaning: no need to say that, don't say that
items.examples: [{"chinese":"A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。","pinyin":"A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.","english":"A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right."}]

[{"chinese":"A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？","pinyin":"A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?","english":"A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?"}]

items.meaning: to pursue, to seek, to aspire to
items.examples: [{"chinese":"在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。","pinyin":"Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.","english":"On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams."}]

[{"chinese":"李導演因為拍那部電影而跟銀行借了不少錢。","pinyin":"Lǐ dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi nà bù diànyǐng ér gēn yínháng jièle bùshǎo qián.","english":"Director Li, because he was filming that movie, borrowed quite a lot of money from the bank."}]

[{"chinese":"沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。","pinyin":"Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.","english":"I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s."}]

[{"chinese":"追求學問就是要多用腦，不斷地學，不斷地問。","pinyin":"Zhuīqiú xuéwèn jiùshì yào duō yòng nǎo, bùduàn de xué, bùduàn de wèn.","english":"Pursuing learning means using your brain more, constantly learning, and constantly asking questions."}]

[{"chinese":"想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。","pinyin":"Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.","english":"If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources."}]

[{"chinese":"小明從小就很勇敢，希望長大後能當一名好警察。","pinyin":"Xiǎomíng cóngxiǎo jiù hěn yǒnggǎn, xīwàng zhǎngdà hòu néng dāng yī míng hǎo jǐngchá.","english":"Xiaoming has been brave since childhood, and he hopes that when he grows up he can become a good police officer."}]

[{"chinese":"李太太擔心孩子因為吃得太少，長不高，你有什麼好主意？","pinyin":"Lǐ tàitai dānxīn háizi yīnwèi chī de tài shǎo, zhǎng bù gāo, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo zhǔyì?","english":"Mrs. Li is worried that her child won't grow tall because he eats too little. Do you have any good ideas?"}]

[{"chinese":"一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。","pinyin":"Yībān rén dōu xǐhuān gēn xìnggé wēnróu, lèguān de rén jiāo péngyǒu.","english":"Most people like to make friends with people who have a gentle and optimistic personality."}]

[{"chinese":"哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。","pinyin":"Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.","english":"My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side."}]

[{"chinese":"沒有人能保證上了有名的大學，未來就一定快樂、幸福。","pinyin":"Méiyǒu rén néng bǎozhèng shàngle yǒumíng de dàxué, wèilái jiù yīdìng kuàilè, xìngfú.","english":"No one can guarantee that if you get into a famous university, you will definitely be happy and blessed in the future."}]

[{"chinese":"在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？","pinyin":"Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?","english":"In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?"}]

[{"chinese":"謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。","pinyin":"Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.","english":"Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job."}]

[{"chinese":"店員把這台咖啡機的特色說明得非常清楚，聽了他的說明以後，大家都很感興趣。","pinyin":"Diànyuán bǎ zhè tái kāfēijī de tèsè shuōmíng de fēicháng qīngchǔ, tīngle tā de shuōmíng yǐhòu, dàjiā dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.","english":"The clerk explained the features of this coffee machine very clearly. After hearing his explanation, everyone was very interested."}]

[{"chinese":"吉米來臺灣五年了，喜歡這裡的食物和人，不過還不能適應夏天的天氣。","pinyin":"Jímǐ lái Táiwān wǔ nián le, xǐhuān zhèlǐ de shíwù hé rén, bùguò hái bù néng shìyìng xiàtiān de tiānqì.","english":"Jimmy has been in Taiwan for five years and likes the food and people here, but he still can't adapt to the summer weather."}]

[{"chinese":"小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。","pinyin":"Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.","english":"Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win."}]

[{"chinese":"我住的房子不大，也沒有很多錢，可是家人都很愛我， 讓我覺得很幸福、很滿足。","pinyin":"Wǒ zhù de fángzi bù dà, yě méiyǒu hěn duō qián, kěshì jiārén dōu hěn ài wǒ, ràng wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú, hěn mǎnzú.","english":"The house I live in isn't big, and I don't have a lot of money, but my family all love me, which makes me feel very happy and satisfied."}]

[{"chinese":"何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。","pinyin":"Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.","english":"Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her."}]

items.meaning: to match, to fit, to blend
items.examples: [{"chinese":"童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。","pinyin":"Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.","english":"Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree."}]

[{"chinese":"媽媽替我報名了亞洲鋼琴比賽，她說只要我肯努力，一定會有好成績的。","pinyin":"Māma tì wǒ bàomíngle Yàzhōu gāngqín bǐsài, tā shuō zhǐyào wǒ kěn nǔlì, yīdìng huì yǒu hǎo chéngjī de.","english":"My mother signed me up for the Asian Piano Competition. She said that as long as I am willing to work hard, I will definitely get good results."}]

[{"chinese":"A:我希望將來能當一名很棒的導演。 B:我相信只要你不斷地努力，就能夢想成真的！","pinyin":"A: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng yī míng hěn bàng de dǎoyǎn. B: Wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào nǐ bùduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de!","english":"A: I hope that in the future I can become a great director. B: I believe that as long as you keep working hard, your dreams will come true!"}]

[{"chinese":"小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！","pinyin":"Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!","english":"Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!"}]

[{"chinese":"便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。","pinyin":"Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.","english":"The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc."}]

[{"chinese":"爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。","pinyin":"Yéye xiànzài měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bùdàn jīngshén hǎo le, shēntǐ yě biàn jiànkāng le.","english":"Grandpa now goes to bed early and gets up early every day. Not only is his spirit better, but his health has also become better."}]

[{"chinese":"大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。","pinyin":"Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.","english":"Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things."}]

[{"chinese":"小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.","english":"Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant."}]

[{"chinese":"這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。","pinyin":"Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.","english":"This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce."}]

[{"chinese":"那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。","pinyin":"Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.","english":"That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try."}]

[{"chinese":"我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。","pinyin":"Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.","english":"Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people."}]

[{"chinese":"小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.","english":"Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier."}]

items.meaning: by the way..., while you're at it..., convenient (ly)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"小歐為了省錢，整個月都吃泡麵，最後吃壞了身體，吃藥、住院花了更多錢。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Ōu wèile shěng qián, zhěngge yuè dōu chī pàomiàn, zuìhòu chī huài le shēntǐ, chī yào, zhùyuàn huā le gèng duō qián.","english":"In order to save money, Xiao Ou ate instant noodles for a whole month; in the end, he ruined his health, and spent even more money on medicine and hospitalization."}]

items.meaning: to make use of, to employ
items.examples: [{"chinese":"現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。","pinyin":"Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.","english":"Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras."}]

[{"chinese":"為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。","pinyin":"Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.","english":"For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy."}]

[{"chinese":"這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。","pinyin":"Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.","english":"This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want."}]

[{"chinese":"這個城市的空氣變乾淨了，主要是因為有捷運以後，開車的人比以前少了。","pinyin":"Zhège chéngshì de kōngqì biàn gānjìng le, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi yǒu jiéyùn yǐhòu, kāichē de rén bǐ yǐqián shǎo le.","english":"The air in this city has become cleaner, mainly because after the MRT was built, fewer people drive than before."}]

items.meaning: Automatic Teller Machine (ATM), commonly used in oral expression

items.examples: [{"chinese":"因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.","english":"Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave."}]

[{"chinese":"早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。","pinyin":"Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.","english":"When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock."}]

items.meaning: forget about it, let it pass
items.examples: [{"chinese":"A:小李怎麼還不來？等了半天， 我快餓死了。 B:算了，我們先吃吧，要不然菜涼了就不好吃了！","pinyin":"A: Xiǎo Lǐ zěnme hái bù lái? Děng le bàntiān, wǒ kuài è sǐ le. B: Suàn le, wǒmen xiān chī ba, yàobùrán cài liáng le jiù bù hǎochī le!","english":"A: Why isn't Xiao Li here yet? I've been waiting forever, I'm starving to death. B: Forget about it, let's eat first, otherwise the food will get cold and won't taste good!"}]

[{"chinese":"過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。","pinyin":"Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.","english":"When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively."}]

items.meaning: to join, to connect, to attach
items.examples: [{"chinese":"在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。","pinyin":"Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.","english":"In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move."}]

items.meaning: usually referring to something "turning up at one's door"

items.examples: [{"chinese":"今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。","pinyin":"Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.","english":"At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time."}]

[{"chinese":"對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。","pinyin":"Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.","english":"For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends."}]

[{"chinese":"公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。","pinyin":"Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.","english":"The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star."}]

[{"chinese":"那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。","pinyin":"Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.","english":"That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them."}]

[{"chinese":"小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.","english":"Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university."}]

[{"chinese":"那個人看起來很神祕，大家都不知道他從哪裡來、做什麼工作。","pinyin":"Nà ge rén kàn qǐlái hěn shénmì, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào tā cóng nǎlǐ lái, zuò shénme gōngzuò.","english":"That person looks very mysterious; everyone doesn't know where he comes from or what job he does."}]

[{"chinese":"爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。","pinyin":"Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.","english":"Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile."}]

items.meaning: (literally) to sound once, here means to make a notice
items.examples: [{"chinese":"舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。","pinyin":"Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.","english":"My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help."}]

[{"chinese":"臺灣一般舊公寓的房子大約三十多坪，有客廳、廚房、一間浴室和三間臥房。","pinyin":"Táiwān yìbān jiù gōngyù de fángzi dàyuē sānshí duō píng, yǒu kètīng, chúfáng, yì jiān yùshì hé sān jiān wòfáng.","english":"A typical old apartment in Taiwan is about thirty-something ping, with a living room, a kitchen, one bathroom, and three bedrooms."}]

[{"chinese":"這個城市的公車司機不找錢，要是你沒有公車卡，就得自己準備零錢。","pinyin":"Zhège chéngshì de gōngchē sījī bù zhǎo qián, yàoshi nǐ méiyǒu gōngchē kǎ, jiù děi zìjǐ zhǔnbèi língqián.","english":"Bus drivers in this city don't give change; if you don't have a bus card, you have to prepare exact change yourself."}]

[{"chinese":"剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。","pinyin":"Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.","english":"If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal."}]

[{"chinese":"昨天小康碰到一位好久不見的老朋友，他們聊天聊到很晚才回家。","pinyin":"Zuótiān Xiǎo Kāng pèng dào yí wèi hǎojiǔ bú jiàn de lǎo péngyǒu, tāmen liáotiān liáo dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā.","english":"Yesterday, Xiao Kang bumped into an old friend he hadn't seen for a long time; they chatted until very late before going home."}]

[{"chinese":"大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。","pinyin":"Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.","english":"Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt."}]

[{"chinese":"那位服務生不笑的時候，樣子看起來很兇，其實他對客人的態度很好。","pinyin":"Nà wèi fúwùshēng bù xiào de shíhou, yàngzi kàn qǐlái hěn xiōng, qíshí tā duì kèrén de tàidù hěn hǎo.","english":"When that waiter doesn't smile, he looks very fierce, but actually his attitude toward customers is very good."}]

[{"chinese":"錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。","pinyin":"Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.","english":"Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster."}]

[{"chinese":"外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。","pinyin":"Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.","english":"Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster."}]

[{"chinese":"如果只注意別人的缺點，就永遠看不到他們的優點了。","pinyin":"Rúguǒ zhǐ zhùyì biérén de quēdiǎn, jiù yǒngyuǎn kàn bù dào tāmen de yōudiǎn le.","english":"If you only pay attention to others' shortcomings, you will never see their strengths."}]

items.meaning: take, with, by means of; according to, as it's...
items.examples: [{"chinese":"媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。","pinyin":"Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.","english":"Mom said to older brother, \"Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying.\""}]

[{"chinese":"你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？","pinyin":"Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?","english":"When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?"}]

items.meaning: to suffer losses, to be taken advantage of
items.examples: [{"chinese":"小元昨天剛買了一件八千元的大衣，沒想到那家服裝店今天打三折，他太吃虧了。","pinyin":"Xiǎoyuán zuótiān gāng mǎi le yī jiàn bāqiān yuán de dàyī, méi xiǎngdào nà jiā fúzhuāngdiàn jīntiān dǎ sān zhé, tā tài chīkuī le.","english":"Xiaoyuan just bought an 8,000-yuan coat yesterday; unexpectedly, that clothing store is having a 70% off sale today—he really suffered a loss."}]

[{"chinese":"為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。","pinyin":"Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.","english":"In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day."}]
[{"chinese":"像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。","pinyin":"Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.","english":"Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people."}]

[{"chinese":"小文為了得到超商送的小禮物，每天都特地去那裡買咖啡、三明治。","pinyin":"Xiǎowén wèile dédào chāoshāng sòng de xiǎo lǐwù, měitiān dōu tèdì qù nàlǐ mǎi kāfēi, sānmíngzhì.","english":"In order to get the small gift from the convenience store, Xiaowen specially goes there every day to buy coffee and sandwiches."}]

[{"chinese":"這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。","pinyin":"Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.","english":"The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store."}]

[{"chinese":"那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。","pinyin":"Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.","english":"What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him."}]

[{"chinese":"小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.","english":"Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous."}]

items.meaning: dress (M: 件 jiàn, 套 tào)
items.simple: dress (M: 件 jiàn, 套 tào)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。","pinyin":"Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.","english":"Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her."}]

[{"chinese":"周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。","pinyin":"Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.","english":"Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on."}]

[{"chinese":"金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。","pinyin":"Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.","english":"When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close."}]
[{"chinese":"雖然小馬的個子不高，不過籃球打得可好了。","pinyin":"Suīrán Xiǎo Mǎ de gèzi bù gāo, bùguò lánqiú dǎ de kě hǎo le.","english":"Although Xiao Ma's build is not tall, he plays basketball really well."}]

[{"chinese":"客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。","pinyin":"Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.","english":"Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger."}]

[{"chinese":"這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。","pinyin":"Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.","english":"The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad."}]

[{"chinese":"最近很多人感冒了，不過不必太擔心，只要戴上口罩、別去人多的地方就行了。","pinyin":"Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào le, bùguò bùbì tài dānxīn, zhǐyào dài shàng kǒuzhào, bié qù rén duō de dìfāng jiù xíng le.","english":"Many people have caught colds recently, but you don't need to worry too much; as long as you wear a mask and don't go to crowded places, it's all right."}]

[{"chinese":"陳小姐今天穿了一件跟我相同牌子的洋裝，還好顏色不同。","pinyin":"Chén xiǎojiě jīntiān chuān le yī jiàn gēn wǒ xiāngtóng páizi de yángzhuāng, hái hǎo yánsè bùtóng.","english":"Miss Chen wore a dress of the same brand as mine today; fortunately, the color is different."}]

[{"chinese":"他們特地穿上情侶裝出門，好像要告訴大家他們是幸福的情侶。","pinyin":"Tāmen tèdì chuān shàng qínglǚzhuāng chūmén, hǎoxiàng yào gàosu dàjiā tāmen shì xìngfú de qínglǚ.","english":"They specially put on matching couple's clothes to go out, as if they want to tell everyone that they are a happy couple."}]

[{"chinese":"他們特地穿上情侶裝出門，好像要告訴大家他們是幸福的情侶。","pinyin":"Tāmen tèdì chuān shàng qínglǚzhuāng chūmén, hǎoxiàng yào gàosu dàjiā tāmen shì xìngfú de qínglǚ.","english":"They specially put on matching couple's clothes to go out, as if they want to tell everyone that they are a happy couple."}]

[{"chinese":"在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。","pinyin":"Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.","english":"In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn."}]

[{"chinese":"室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。","pinyin":"Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.","english":"My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit."}]

[{"chinese":"冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。","pinyin":"Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.","english":"As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare."}]

[{"chinese":"小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。","pinyin":"Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.","english":"Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left."}]

[{"chinese":"小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。","pinyin":"Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.","english":"Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red."}]

[{"chinese":"每個人都有自己的優點，不需要強調，也不必跟別人比來比去。","pinyin":"Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, bù xūyào qiángdiào, yě búbì gēn biérén bǐ lái bǐ qù.","english":"Everyone has their own strengths; there is no need to emphasize them, and no need to compare yourself with others back and forth."}]

[{"chinese":"買襯衫的時候得注意肩膀的大小，太大或太小都不合適。","pinyin":"Mǎi chènshān de shíhou děi zhùyì jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo, tài dà huò tài xiǎo dōu bù héshì.","english":"When buying a shirt, you need to pay attention to the size of the shoulders; too big or too small are both unsuitable."}]

[{"chinese":"我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。","pinyin":"Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.","english":"My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters."}]

[{"chinese":"想要吸引顧客來購買價格高的商品，除了品質好，服務態度也很重要。","pinyin":"Xiǎngyào xīyǐn gùkè lái gòumǎi jiàgé gāo de shāngpǐn, chúle pǐnzhì hǎo, fúwù tàidù yě hěn zhòngyào.","english":"If you want to attract customers to buy high-priced products, in addition to good quality, service attitude is also very important."}]

[{"chinese":"醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。","pinyin":"Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.","english":"The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged."}]

[{"chinese":"張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。","pinyin":"Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.","english":"Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot."}]

[{"chinese":"我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。","pinyin":"Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.","english":"I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors."}]

items.meaning: to shop around for the best deal; to comparison shop at more than one store to get the best deal (so as not to have any regrets)
items.pinyin: huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī
items.examples: [{"chinese":"你先別急著買，貨比三家不吃虧，多看幾家再決定吧！","pinyin":"Nǐ xiān bié jízhe mǎi, huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, duō kàn jǐ jiā zài juédìng ba!","english":"Don't rush to buy yet; shopping around at three stores won't hurt—look at a few more stores before deciding!"}]

[{"chinese":"那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。","pinyin":"Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.","english":"Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from."}]

[{"chinese":"我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。","pinyin":"Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.","english":"I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home."}]

[{"chinese":"這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。","pinyin":"Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.","english":"This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it."}]

[{"chinese":"我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。","pinyin":"Wǒ bú rènwéi dìtān méi hǎohuò, yǒu yìxiē dìtān de dōngxi bùjǐn jiàgé piányi, pǐnzhì yě búcuò.","english":"I don't think street stalls have no good goods; some stall items are not only cheap in price, but the quality is also not bad."}]

[{"chinese":"這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。","pinyin":"Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.","english":"Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere."}]

[{"chinese":"何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。","pinyin":"Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.","english":"Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor."}]

[{"chinese":"購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。","pinyin":"Gòuwù shí wǒ xǐhuān yí ge rén mànmàn kàn, bú tài xǐhuān diànyuán yìzhí xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo.","english":"When shopping, I like to look around slowly by myself; I don't really like salesclerks constantly trying to sell to me."}]

[{"chinese":"超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。","pinyin":"Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.","english":"Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang."}]

[{"chinese":"小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。","pinyin":"Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.","english":"Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person."}]

[{"chinese":"李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。","pinyin":"Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.","english":"Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner."}]

items.meaning: to offer a preferential discount; favorable, preferable
items.examples: [{"chinese":"來來來，快來買！我們3C產品的價格最優惠，品質也很好，快把握機會喔！","pinyin":"Lái lái lái, kuài lái mǎi! Wǒmen 3C chǎnpǐn de jiàgé zuì yōuhuì, pǐnzhì yě hěn hǎo, kuài bǎwò jīhuì o!","english":"Come, come, come, hurry and buy! Our 3C products have the most favorable prices and very good quality—grab the opportunity!"}]

[{"chinese":"爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。","pinyin":"Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.","english":"Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things."}]

[{"chinese":"這所大學有最新的電腦設備，提供學生很好的學習環境。","pinyin":"Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒu zuìxīn de diànnǎo shèbèi, tígōng xuéshēng hěn hǎo de xuéxí huánjìng.","english":"This university has the latest computer equipment, providing students with a very good learning environment."}]

[{"chinese":"那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。","pinyin":"Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.","english":"The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price."}]

[{"chinese":"越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。","pinyin":"Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.","english":"More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient."}]

[{"chinese":"經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。","pinyin":"Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.","english":"The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start."}]

[{"chinese":"這首歌很受歡迎，被認為是今年的最佳歌曲。","pinyin":"Zhè shǒu gē hěn shòu huānyíng, bèi rènwéi shì jīnnián de zuìjiā gēqǔ.","english":"This song is very popular and is considered the best song of the year."}]

[{"chinese":"包小姐的眼光很好，一看就知道那件黃色外套的品質最好。妹妹：我希望將來找個又聰明又有錢 ，而且很體貼我的男朋友。 姊姊：妳的眼光太高了，恐怕找不到。","pinyin":"Bāo xiǎojiě de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, yí kàn jiù zhīdào nà jiàn huángsè wàitào de pǐnzhí zuì hǎo. Mèimei: Wǒ xīwàng jiānglái zhǎo ge yòu cōngmíng yòu yǒu qián, érqiě hěn tǐtiē wǒ de nánpéngyou. Jiějie: Nǐ de yǎnguāng tài gāo le, kǒngpà zhǎo bú dào.","english":"Miss Bao has a good eye; she can tell at a glance that the quality of that yellow coat is the best. Younger sister: I hope to find a boyfriend in the future who is smart, rich, and very considerate of me. Older sister: Your standards are too high; I'm afraid you won't find one."}]

items.meaning: in disorderly fashion; act stupidly (foolishly); muddle-headed; mixed up
items.examples: [{"chinese":"小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。","pinyin":"Xiǎolán kàn qǐlái húlǐhútú de, qíshí zuò qǐ shì lái zǐxì de hěn.","english":"Xiaolan looks muddle-headed, but actually she is very careful when doing things."}]

items.meaning: a baby's completion of its first month of life
items.examples: [{"chinese":"在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。","pinyin":"Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.","english":"In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month."}]

[{"chinese":"那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。","pinyin":"Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.","english":"That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous."}]

[{"chinese":"那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。","pinyin":"Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.","english":"That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English."}]

[{"chinese":"他雖然年紀小，但是對人有禮貌，也很體貼父母，是個乖孩子。","pinyin":"Tā suīrán niánjì xiǎo, dànshì duì rén yǒu lǐmào, yě hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, shì ge guāi háizi.","english":"Although he is young, he is polite to people and also very considerate of his parents; he is a well-behaved child."}]

[{"chinese":"有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？","pinyin":"Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?","english":"Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?"}]

[{"chinese":"這是我爺爺抱著我的照片，那時候我才一歲呢！","pinyin":"Zhè shì wǒ yéye bàozhe wǒ de zhàopiàn, nà shíhou wǒ cái yí suì ne!","english":"This is a photo of my grandfather holding me; at that time I was only one year old!"}]

[{"chinese":"張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。","pinyin":"Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.","english":"Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings."}]

items.meaning: red envelope containing money as a gift
items.examples: [{"chinese":"除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！","pinyin":"Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!","english":"On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!"}]

[{"chinese":"華人喜歡像二、六、八的數字，這幾個數字都是雙數，有很多好事一起來的意思。","pinyin":"Huárén xǐhuān xiàng èr, liù, bā de shùzì, zhè jǐ ge shùzì dōu shì shuāngshù, yǒu hěn duō hǎoshì yìqǐ lái de yìsi.","english":"Chinese people like numbers like two, six, and eight; these numbers are all even numbers, which means many good things come together."}]

[{"chinese":"對不起！我昨天跟你說話的態度不好，我向你道歉，請你別生氣了。","pinyin":"Duìbuqǐ! Wǒ zuótiān gēn nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù bù hǎo, wǒ xiàng nǐ dàoqiàn, qǐng nǐ bié shēngqì le.","english":"I'm sorry! My attitude when talking to you yesterday was not good. I apologize to you; please don't be angry anymore."}]

[{"chinese":"尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。","pinyin":"Shàng'ēn shì Jiāháo de hǎo péngyou, fēicháng qīngchǔ tā de gèxìng, lián tā xǐhuān chī shénme dōu hěn qīngchǔ.","english":"Shawn is Jiahao's good friend and is very clear about his personality; he is even very clear about what he likes to eat."}]

[{"chinese":"這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。","pinyin":"Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.","english":"The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars."}]

[{"chinese":"朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。","pinyin":"Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.","english":"My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly."}]

[{"chinese":"為了避免皮膚受傷，夏天出門時別忘了戴上帽子和太陽眼鏡。","pinyin":"Wèile bìmiǎn pífū shòushāng, xiàtiān chūmén shí bié wàng le dài shàng màozi hé tàiyáng yǎnjìng.","english":"To avoid skin injury, don't forget to put on a hat and sunglasses when going out in summer."}]

[{"chinese":"章先生一直想當律師，經過多年的努力，終於夢想成真了。","pinyin":"Zhāng xiānsheng yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī, jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, zhōngyú mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le.","english":"Mr. Zhang has always wanted to be a lawyer. After years of effort, his dream has finally come true."}]

[{"chinese":"那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。","pinyin":"Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.","english":"Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size."}]

[{"chinese":"我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。","pinyin":"Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.","english":"My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year."}]

[{"chinese":"我和朋友到餐廳點了好多菜，最後沒吃完，只好打包回家。","pinyin":"Wǒ hé péngyou dào cāntīng diǎn le hǎo duō cài, zuìhòu méi chī wán, zhǐhǎo dǎbāo huí jiā.","english":"My friend and I went to a restaurant and ordered a lot of dishes. In the end, we couldn't finish them, so we had to pack them to take home."}]

[{"chinese":"我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。","pinyin":"Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.","english":"I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year."}]

[{"chinese":"李先生從不吃泡麵、薯條、熱狗那樣的食物，因為他覺得不健康。","pinyin":"Lǐ xiānshēng cóngbù chī pàomiàn, shǔtiáo, règǒu nàyàng de shíwù, yīnwèi tā juéde bù jiànkāng.","english":"Mr. Li never eats foods like instant noodles, French fries, or hot dogs, because he thinks they are unhealthy."}]

items.meaning: to practice confinement after giving birth
items.examples: [{"chinese":"照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。","pinyin":"Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.","english":"According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old."}]

[{"chinese":"母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。","pinyin":"Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.","english":"On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother."}]

[{"chinese":"就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。","pinyin":"Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.","english":"The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous."}]

[{"chinese":"我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。","pinyin":"Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.","english":"My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him."}]

[{"chinese":"假日我常跟家人一塊兒去郊區爬山、野餐。","pinyin":"Jiàrì wǒ cháng gēn jiārén yīkuàir qù jiāoqū páshān, yěcān.","english":"On holidays, I often go hiking and picnicking in the suburbs together with my family."}]

[{"chinese":"我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。","pinyin":"Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.","english":"Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy."}]

[{"chinese":"多閱讀書報、雜誌，能讓我們的知識更豐富。","pinyin":"Duō yuèdú shūbào, zázhì, néng ràng wǒmen de zhīshì gèng fēngfù.","english":"Reading more books, newspapers, and magazines can make our knowledge richer."}]

[{"chinese":"任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。","pinyin":"Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.","english":"Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly."}]

[{"chinese":"付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！","pinyin":"Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!","english":"When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!"}]

[{"chinese":"不管追求夢想的路上有多辛苦，都是我們一輩子珍貴的回憶。","pinyin":"Bùguǎn zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang yǒu duō xīnkǔ, dōu shì wǒmen yībèizi zhēnguì de huíyì.","english":"No matter how hard the road of pursuing dreams is, it is all precious memories for a lifetime."}]

[{"chinese":"聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？","pinyin":"Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?","english":"I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?"}]

[{"chinese":"我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。","pinyin":"Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.","english":"I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest."}]

[{"chinese":"顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。","pinyin":"Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.","english":"Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings."}]

[{"chinese":"我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。","pinyin":"Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.","english":"I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that."}]

[{"chinese":"週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。","pinyin":"Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.","english":"On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time."}]

[{"chinese":"黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。","pinyin":"Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.","english":"Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly."}]

[{"chinese":"小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.","english":"Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry."}]

[{"chinese":"華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。","pinyin":"Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.","english":"On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year."}]

[{"chinese":"每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。","pinyin":"Měi nián chūnjié shí, bàba dōu huì sòng gébì línjū yī hé píngguǒ, zhù tāmen měi tiān dōu píng'ān, rúyì.","english":"Every year during Spring Festival, Dad gives the neighbor next door a box of apples, wishing them peace and that everything goes as they wish every day."}]

items.meaning: I look forward to hearing the patter of tiny feet
items.examples: [{"chinese":"我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。","pinyin":"Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.","english":"I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever."}]

[{"chinese":"地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？","pinyin":"Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng. Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?","english":"During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury. When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?"}]

[{"chinese":"新聞報告說颱風快來了，出門時得注意安全。","pinyin":"Xīnwén bàogào shuō táifēng kuài lái le, chūmén shí děi zhùyì ānquán.","english":"The news report says a typhoon is coming soon; when going out, you must pay attention to safety."}]

[{"chinese":"強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。","pinyin":"Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.","english":"Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses."}]

[{"chinese":"那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。","pinyin":"Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.","english":"That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment."}]

[{"chinese":"這個社區的周圍有山有水，空氣也很好，這樣的生活環境很適合退休的人。","pinyin":"Zhège shèqū de zhōuwéi yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, kōngqì yě hěn hǎo, zhèyàng de shēnghuó huánjìng hěn shìhé tuìxiū de rén.","english":"The neighborhood of this community has mountains and water, and the air is also very good; such a living environment is very suitable for retired people."}]

[{"chinese":"那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。","pinyin":"Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.","english":"That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured."}]

[{"chinese":"那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。","pinyin":"Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.","english":"That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today."}]

[{"chinese":"下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。","pinyin":"Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.","english":"It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned."}]

[{"chinese":"我家的狗很乖，從不破壞家裡的東西。颱風快來了，破壞了我本來要去露營的計畫。","pinyin":"Wǒ jiā de gǒu hěn guāi, cóng bù pòhuài jiālǐ de dōngxī. Táifēng kuài lái le, pòhuài le wǒ běnlái yào qù lùyíng de jìhuà.","english":"Our dog is very well-behaved and never destroys things in the house. The typhoon is coming soon, and it destroyed my original plan to go camping."}]

[{"chinese":"孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。","pinyin":"Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.","english":"Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy."}]

[{"chinese":"這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。","pinyin":"Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.","english":"This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad."}]

[{"chinese":"糟了！衣服被咖啡弄髒了，我得換一件才能出門。","pinyin":"Zāo le! Yīfu bèi kāfēi nòng zāng le, wǒ děi huàn yī jiàn cái néng chūmén.","english":"Uh-oh! My clothes got dirty from coffee; I have to change into another piece before I can go out."}]

[{"chinese":"因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.","english":"Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement."}]

[{"chinese":"這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。","pinyin":"Zhè jǐ tiān diànshì shàng yīlián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎoyǎn pāi de diànyǐng, yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎokàn.","english":"These past few days, the TV has played several movies directed by the same director in succession; each one is better than the last."}]

[{"chinese":"這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！","pinyin":"Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!","english":"This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!"}]

[{"chinese":"昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。","pinyin":"Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.","english":"Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured."}]

[{"chinese":"從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。","pinyin":"Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.","english":"Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi."}]

[{"chinese":"現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。","pinyin":"Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.","english":"Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home."}]

[{"chinese":"因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.","english":"Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help."}]

[{"chinese":"這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。","pinyin":"Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.","english":"This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day."}]

items.meaning: candle (M: 根 gēn, 枝 zhī)
items.examples: [{"chinese":"今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。","pinyin":"Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.","english":"Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age."}]
items.simple: candle (M: 根 gēn, 枝 zhī)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。","pinyin":"Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.","english":"In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class."}]

[{"chinese":"在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。","pinyin":"Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.","english":"When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire."}]

[{"chinese":"為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。","pinyin":"Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.","english":"In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day."}]

[{"chinese":"我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。","pinyin":"Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.","english":"When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up."}]

items.meaning: sound of wind blowing and rain falling
items.examples: [{"chinese":"昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。","pinyin":"Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ shēng hǎo kěpà, ràng wǒ zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo.","english":"Last night the sound of wind and rain was so scary that it kept me from sleeping well the whole night."}]

[{"chinese":"A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。","pinyin":"A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.","english":"A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good."}]

items.simple: island in the sea (M: 座 zuò)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。","pinyin":"Táiwān shì yī gè hǎidǎo guójiā, zhōuwéi de hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de zhēnguì zīyuán.","english":"Taiwan is an island country; the seabed around it has rich and precious resources."}]

[{"chinese":"醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。","pinyin":"Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.","english":"The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time."}]

[{"chinese":"那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。","pinyin":"Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.","english":"That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good."}]

[{"chinese":"這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。","pinyin":"Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.","english":"This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses."}]

[{"chinese":"世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。","pinyin":"Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.","english":"The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate."}]

[{"chinese":"弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。","pinyin":"Dìdi gǎnmào le, kěshì tā búdàn bù chī yào, hái yíliàn chī le sān wǎn bīng, jiéguǒ késou ké de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng le.","english":"My younger brother caught a cold, but not only did he not take medicine, he even ate three bowls of ice cream in a row; as a result, his cough became more and more serious."}]

[{"chinese":"這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。","pinyin":"Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.","english":"This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke."}]

[{"chinese":"夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。","pinyin":"Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.","english":"On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things."}]

[{"chinese":"東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。","pinyin":"Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.","english":"In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents."}]

[{"chinese":"這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。","pinyin":"Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.","english":"Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working."}]

[{"chinese":"因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.","english":"Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed."}]

items.meaning: to be stuck, stranded, hard pressed
items.examples: [{"chinese":"前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。","pinyin":"Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.","english":"There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route."}]

[{"chinese":"因為天氣太熱了，有一隻貓在車子底下休息，不肯離開。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè le, yǒu yì zhī māo zài chēzi dǐxià xiūxi, bù kěn líkāi.","english":"Because the weather is too hot, a cat is resting under the car and refuses to leave."}]

[{"chinese":"我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！","pinyin":"Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!","english":"Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!"}]

[{"chinese":"臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。","pinyin":"Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.","english":"When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help."}]

[{"chinese":"A:醫生，我求你快救救我的貓。 B:別急！我馬上檢查。","pinyin":"A: Yīshēng, wǒ qiú nǐ kuài jiùjiu wǒ de māo. B: Bié jí! Wǒ mǎshàng jiǎnchá.","english":"A: Doctor, I beg you to save my cat quickly. B: Don't worry! I'll examine it right away."}]

[{"chinese":"那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。","pinyin":"Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.","english":"After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving."}]

[{"chinese":"當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。","pinyin":"Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.","english":"As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work."}]

[{"chinese":"救災工作不容易，一個人的力量是不夠的，得大家一起來。","pinyin":"Jiùzāi gōngzuò bù róngyì, yí ge rén de lìliàng shì bú gòu de, děi dàjiā yìqǐ lái.","english":"Disaster relief work is not easy; one person's strength is not enough—everyone needs to come together."}]

[{"chinese":"這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。","pinyin":"1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.","english":"1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow."}]

[{"chinese":"有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。","pinyin":"Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.","english":"Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them."}]

[{"chinese":"一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。","pinyin":"Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.","english":"As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods."}]

[{"chinese":"軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。","pinyin":"Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.","english":"Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need."}]

items.meaning: to share one's strength or power
items.examples: [{"chinese":"只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。","pinyin":"Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.","english":"Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner."}]

items.meaning: to bring out innate or acquired qualities
items.examples: [{"chinese":"九二一大地震時，臺灣人發揮了互相幫助的精神，讓人非常感動。","pinyin":"Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn shí, Táiwān rén fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.","english":"During the 921 earthquake, Taiwanese people brought out the spirit of helping one another, which was very moving."}]

[{"chinese":"從明天起天氣會變冷，溫度會比今天降低五度，出門時最好穿上外套。","pinyin":"Cóng míngtiān qǐ tiānqì huì biàn lěng, wēndù huì bǐ jīntiān jiàngdī wǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo chuān shàng wàitào.","english":"Starting tomorrow, the weather will turn cold; the temperature will drop five degrees compared to today, so it's best to put on a jacket when going out."}]

[{"chinese":"那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。","pinyin":"Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.","english":"That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful."}]

[{"chinese":"醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。","pinyin":"Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.","english":"A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors."}]

items.meaning: life; luck, destiny, fate (M: 條 tiáo)
items.examples: [{"chinese":"沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。","pinyin":"Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.","english":"No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it."}]

[{"chinese":"我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。","pinyin":"Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng. Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.","english":"My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping. For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays."}]

[{"chinese":"如果這個週末你沒有什麼打算，要不要跟我去看看臺灣規模最大的書店？","pinyin":"Rúguǒ zhège zhōumò nǐ méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn, yào bù yào gēn wǒ qù kànkan Táiwān guīmó zuì dà de shūdiàn?","english":"If you don't have any plans this weekend, do you want to go with me to see Taiwan's largest bookstore?"}]

[{"chinese":"我本來打算下星期騎車環島，但是颱風剛過，想來想去，還是決定不去了。","pinyin":"Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn xià xīngqī qíchē huándǎo, dànshì táifēng gāng guò, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bù qù le.","english":"I originally planned to go around the island by bike next week, but the typhoon just passed, and after thinking it over, I decided not to go after all."}]

[{"chinese":"A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。","pinyin":"A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.","english":"A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything."}]

[{"chinese":"大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。","pinyin":"Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.","english":"Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level."}]

[{"chinese":"這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。","pinyin":"Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.","english":"This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors."}]

[{"chinese":"王老闆舉辦了一個免費吃鬆餅的活動，目的是調查哪種口味的鬆餅最受歡迎。","pinyin":"Wáng lǎobǎn jǔbàn le yīgè miǎnfèi chī sōngbǐng de huódòng, mùdì shì diàochá nǎ zhǒng kǒuwèi de sōngbǐng zuì shòu huānyíng.","english":"Boss Wang held an event with free waffles; the purpose was to investigate which flavor of waffle is most popular."}]

[{"chinese":"這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。","pinyin":"Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.","english":"It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable."}]

[{"chinese":"市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。","pinyin":"Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.","english":"In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools."}]

[{"chinese":"大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。","pinyin":"Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.","english":"Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved."}]

[{"chinese":"每年冬天快到時，舅舅和舅媽就開始計畫去滑雪，有時還約我跟媽媽一起去。","pinyin":"Měi nián dōngtiān kuài dào shí, jiùjiu hé jiùmā jiù kāishǐ jìhuà qù huáxuě, yǒushí hái yuē wǒ gēn māma yīqǐ qù.","english":"Every year when winter is approaching, my uncle and aunt start planning to go skiing, and sometimes they even invite me and my mom to go together."}]

[{"chinese":"滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。","pinyin":"Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.","english":"Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days."}]
