[{"chinese":"王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。","pinyin":"Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.","english":"Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner."}]

[{"chinese":"透過教授的介紹，我一畢業就順利地找到了滿意的工作。","pinyin":"Tòuguò jiàoshòu de jièshào, wǒ yī bìyè jiù shùnlì de zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò.","english":"Through the professor's introduction, I smoothly found a satisfactory job as soon as I graduated."}]

[{"chinese":"他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。","pinyin":"Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.","english":"He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated."}]

[{"chinese":"有個騙子吃完了麵，假裝忘記帶錢包，騙老闆要回家拿錢，一離開就沒回來了。","pinyin":"Yǒu ge piànzi chī wán le miàn, jiǎzhuāng wàngjì dài qiánbāo, piàn lǎobǎn yào huí jiā ná qián, yī líkāi jiù méi huílái le.","english":"A cheater finished eating noodles and pretended to have forgotten his wallet; he tricked the owner into letting him go home to get money, and as soon as he left, he never came back."}]

[{"chinese":"A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。","pinyin":"A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.","english":"A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt."}]

[{"chinese":"那個老闆做生意不老實，一再跟客人保證商品沒問題，其實是騙人的。","pinyin":"Nàge lǎobǎn zuò shēngyì bù lǎoshí, yīzài gēn kèrén bǎozhèng shāngpǐn méi wèntí, qíshí shì piànrén de.","english":"That boss is not honest in doing business; he repeatedly assures customers that the products have no problems, but actually it's a scam."}]

[{"chinese":"地球的表面大約百分之七十是水，百分之三十是地。","pinyin":"Dìqiú de biǎomiàn dàyuē bǎifēnzhī qīshí shì shuǐ, bǎifēnzhī sānshí shì dì.","english":"About seventy percent of the Earth's surface is water, and thirty percent is land."}]

items.meaning: on, on the aspect of, adverb marker
items.examples: [{"chinese":"今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。","pinyin":"Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.","english":"During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside."}]

[{"chinese":"他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。","pinyin":"Tā tòuguò wǎnglù rènshi le yī wèi wǎngyǒu, zhídào jiéhūn qián, tāmen cái jiàn guò duìfāng sān cì.","english":"He met an online friend through the Internet, and they had only seen each other three times before they got married."}]

[{"chinese":"跟張先生聊天時，總是我問一句，他答一句，真沒意思。","pinyin":"Gēn Zhāng xiānsheng liáotiān shí, zǒngshì wǒ wèn yī jù, tā dá yī jù, zhēn méi yìsi.","english":"When chatting with Mr. Zhang, it's always I ask one sentence and he answers one sentence; it's really boring."}]

[{"chinese":"A:好久沒看到你父母了，請替我問候他們。 B:沒問題。","pinyin":"A: Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào nǐ fùmǔ le, qǐng tì wǒ wènhòu tāmen. B: Méi wèntí.","english":"A: I haven't seen your parents for a long time; please give them my regards. B: No problem."}]

[{"chinese":"大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。","pinyin":"Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.","english":"The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities."}]
[{"chinese":"這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。","pinyin":"Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.","english":"This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here."}]

[{"chinese":"每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。","pinyin":"Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.","english":"Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough."}]

[{"chinese":"有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。","pinyin":"Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.","english":"A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future."}]

[{"chinese":"有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。","pinyin":"Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.","english":"Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online."}]

[{"chinese":"我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。","pinyin":"Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.","english":"The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often."}]

items.meaning: to sympathize with, to feel pity for
items.examples: [{"chinese":"在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。","pinyin":"Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.","english":"In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him."}]

[{"chinese":"他是一個誠實的孩子，做錯事一定會勇敢承認的。","pinyin":"Tā shì yī ge chéngshí de háizi, zuò cuò shì yīdìng huì yǒnggǎn chéngrèn de.","english":"He is an honest child; if he does something wrong, he will definitely bravely admit it."}]
[{"chinese":"那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。","pinyin":"Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.","english":"That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked."}]

[{"chinese":"那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！","pinyin":"Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!","english":"That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!"}]

[{"chinese":"從小父母就教導我要做個好人，別讓人看不起自己。","pinyin":"Cóngxiǎo fùmǔ jiù jiàodǎo wǒ yào zuò ge hǎorén, bié ràng rén kànbuqǐ zìjǐ.","english":"Since I was little, my parents taught me to be a good person and not let others look down on me."}]

[{"chinese":"小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。","pinyin":"Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.","english":"When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy."}]

[{"chinese":"這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。","pinyin":"Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.","english":"This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe."}]

[{"chinese":"小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.","english":"Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her."}]

[{"chinese":"這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。","pinyin":"Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.","english":"This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved."}]

[{"chinese":"何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。","pinyin":"Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.","english":"Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind."}]

[{"chinese":"我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。","pinyin":"Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.","english":"The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me."}]
[{"chinese":"你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？","pinyin":"Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?","english":"Do you know where the first World Games were held?"}]

[{"chinese":"從我加入這個健身社團後，不但作息正常了，身體也更健康了。","pinyin":"Cóng wǒ jiārù zhège jiànshēn shètuán hòu, bùdàn zuòxī zhèngcháng le, shēntǐ yě gèng jiànkāng le.","english":"Ever since I joined this fitness club, not only has my daily routine become regular, but my health has also improved."}]

[{"chinese":"透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。","pinyin":"Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.","english":"Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling."}]

[{"chinese":"那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。","pinyin":"Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.","english":"Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day."}]

items.meaning: modern times, the contemporary age; modern
items.examples: [{"chinese":"現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。","pinyin":"Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.","english":"Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms."}]

[{"chinese":"只要照溫老師安排的課程，多閱讀、多練習，你的中文就會有很大的進步。","pinyin":"Zhǐyào zhào Wēn lǎoshī ānpái de kèchéng, duō yuèdú, duō liànxí, nǐ de Zhōngwén jiù huì yǒu hěn dà de jìnbù.","english":"As long as you follow the curriculum arranged by Teacher Wen, read more and practice more, your Chinese will make great progress."}]

[{"chinese":"我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。","pinyin":"Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.","english":"My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express."}]

[{"chinese":"A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。","pinyin":"A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.","english":"A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature."}]

[{"chinese":"許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。","pinyin":"Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.","english":"Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it."}]

[{"chinese":"我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。","pinyin":"Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.","english":"I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy."}]

[{"chinese":"你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。","pinyin":"Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.","english":"The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting."}]

[{"chinese":"簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。","pinyin":"Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.","english":"Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries."}]

[{"chinese":"人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。","pinyin":"Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.","english":"Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future."}]

[{"chinese":"我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。","pinyin":"Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.","english":"I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone."}]

[{"chinese":"當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。","pinyin":"Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.","english":"When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us."}]

[{"chinese":"林阿姨來我家推銷保險，我不好意思當面拒絕她，只好假裝有急事要出門。","pinyin":"Lín āyí lái wǒ jiā tuīxiāo bǎoxiǎn, wǒ bù hǎoyìsi dāngmiàn jùjué tā, zhǐhǎo jiǎzhuāng yǒu jíshì yào chūmén.","english":"Auntie Lin came to my house to sell insurance; I was too embarrassed to refuse her in person, so I had no choice but to pretend I had an urgent matter and had to go out."}]

[{"chinese":"學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。","pinyin":"Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.","english":"Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal."}]

[{"chinese":"他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？","pinyin":"Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?","english":"His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?"}]

[{"chinese":"前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。","pinyin":"Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.","english":"A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up."}]

[{"chinese":"出國留學有不少好處，例如打開視野、增加自信、提高外文程度等等。","pinyin":"Chūguó liúxué yǒu bùshǎo hǎochù, lìrú dǎkāi shìyě, zēngjiā zìxìn, tígāo wàiwén chéngdù děngděng.","english":"Studying abroad has many benefits, for example, broadening one's horizons, increasing self-confidence, improving foreign language proficiency, and so on."}]

[{"chinese":"某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。","pinyin":"Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.","english":"On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now."}]

[{"chinese":"那對雙胞胎長得很像，個性卻很不同，哥哥很大方，弟弟很害羞。","pinyin":"Nà duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de hěn xiàng, gèxìng què hěn bùtóng, gēge hěn dàfāng, dìdi hěn hàixiū.","english":"That pair of twins look very much alike, but their personalities are very different: the older brother is very outgoing, and the younger brother is very shy."}]

[{"chinese":"何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。","pinyin":"Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.","english":"Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all."}]

[{"chinese":"小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.","english":"Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing."}]

[{"chinese":"麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！","pinyin":"Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!","english":"Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!"}]

[{"chinese":"人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。","pinyin":"Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.","english":"Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad."}]

[{"chinese":"媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。","pinyin":"Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.","english":"When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child."}]

[{"chinese":"石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。","pinyin":"Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.","english":"Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife."}]

[{"chinese":"老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。","pinyin":"Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.","english":"Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?"}]

[{"chinese":"我知道那輛德國汽車很貴，至於到底多貴，我就不清楚了。","pinyin":"Wǒ zhīdào nà liàng Déguó qìchē hěn guì, zhìyú dàodǐ duō guì, wǒ jiù bù qīngchu le.","english":"I know that German car is very expensive; as to exactly how expensive, I'm not clear."}]

[{"chinese":"一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。","pinyin":"Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.","english":"Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them."}]

[{"chinese":"有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。","pinyin":"Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.","english":"With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games."}]

[{"chinese":"那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。","pinyin":"Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.","english":"That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks."}]

[{"chinese":"弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。","pinyin":"Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.","english":"Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview."}]

[{"chinese":"A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。","pinyin":"A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.","english":"A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today."}]

[{"chinese":"在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？","pinyin":"Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?","english":"In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?"}]

[{"chinese":"明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。","pinyin":"Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.","english":"Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late."}]

[{"chinese":"假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。","pinyin":"Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.","english":"If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance."}]

[{"chinese":"A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。","pinyin":"A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.","english":"A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang."}]

[{"chinese":"那個店員的工作態度很隨便，常弄錯商品的價格，還找錯錢， 真是太誇張了！","pinyin":"Nàge diànyuán de gōngzuò tàidù hěn suíbiàn, cháng nòngcuò shāngpǐn de jiàgé, hái zhǎo cuò qián, zhēn shì tài kuāzhāng le!","english":"That clerk's work attitude is very careless; he often gets the product prices wrong and also gives the wrong change—that's really too outrageous!"}]

[{"chinese":"不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。","pinyin":"Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.","english":"Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again."}]

[{"chinese":"方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。","pinyin":"Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.","english":"Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper."}]

[{"chinese":"大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。","pinyin":"Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.","english":"Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him."}]

[{"chinese":"雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。","pinyin":"Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.","english":"Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school."}]

[{"chinese":"每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。","pinyin":"Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.","english":"Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier."}]

[{"chinese":"對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。","pinyin":"Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.","english":"For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan."}]

[{"chinese":"現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。","pinyin":"Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.","english":"Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls."}]

[{"chinese":"易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。","pinyin":"Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.","english":"After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society."}]

[{"chinese":"管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。","pinyin":"Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.","english":"Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home."}]

[{"chinese":"我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。","pinyin":"Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.","english":"Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school."}]

[{"chinese":"老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。","pinyin":"Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.","english":"The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly."}]

[{"chinese":"我父親是個警察，只要他負責的小組有重要任務時，就得出差一兩個星期。","pinyin":"Wǒ fùqīn shì ge jǐngchá, zhǐyào tā fùzé de xiǎozǔ yǒu zhòngyào rènwu shí, jiù děi chūchāi yī liǎng ge xīngqī.","english":"My father is a police officer; whenever the team he is responsible for has an important task, he has to go on a business trip for one or two weeks."}]

[{"chinese":"A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。","pinyin":"A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.","english":"A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving."}]

[{"chinese":"結婚之前，那對情侶認真規劃了未來的生活，沒想到結婚一個月之後就離婚了。","pinyin":"Jiéhūn zhīqián, nà duì qínglǚ rènzhēn guīhuà le wèilái de shēnghuó, méi xiǎngdào jiéhūn yí ge yuè zhīhòu jiù líhūn le.","english":"Before getting married, that couple carefully planned their future life; unexpectedly, they divorced just one month after getting married."}]

[{"chinese":"商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。","pinyin":"Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.","english":"Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you."}]

[{"chinese":"史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。","pinyin":"Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.","english":"Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos."}]

[{"chinese":"顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。","pinyin":"Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.","english":"Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work."}]

[{"chinese":"人人都喜歡薪水高、離家近、輕鬆的工作，不過這往往只是一個夢。","pinyin":"Rénrén dōu xǐhuan xīnshuǐ gāo, lí jiā jìn, qīngsōng de gōngzuò, búguò zhè wǎngwǎng zhǐshì yí ge mèng.","english":"Everyone likes a job with a high salary, close to home, and easy, but this is often just a dream."}]

[{"chinese":"這家公司福利不錯，每年除了提供免費健檢，老闆還會帶員工出國旅遊。","pinyin":"Zhè jiā gōngsī fúlì búcuò, měinián chúle tígōng miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn, lǎobǎn hái huì dài yuángōng chūguó lǚyóu.","english":"This company's benefits are quite good; every year, in addition to providing free health checkups, the boss also takes the employees on overseas trips."}]

[{"chinese":"有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。","pinyin":"Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.","english":"Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public."}]

[{"chinese":"剛進公司的員工對環境比較陌生，對工作內容也不熟悉，多多少少需要協助。","pinyin":"Gāng jìn gōngsī de yuángōng duì huánjìng bǐjiào mòshēng, duì gōngzuò nèiróng yě bù shúxī, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào xiézhù.","english":"Employees who have just joined the company are relatively unfamiliar with the environment and are also not familiar with the work content, so they more or less need assistance."}]

[{"chinese":"我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。","pinyin":"Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.","english":"The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help."}]

[{"chinese":"這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。","pinyin":"Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.","english":"This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit."}]

[{"chinese":"你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？","pinyin":"Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?","english":"After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?"}]

[{"chinese":"現代企業越來越重視員工的福利和健康，例如提供免費的旅遊和健檢。","pinyin":"Xiàndài qǐyè yuèláiyuè zhòngshì yuángōng de fúlì hé jiànkāng, lìrú tígōng miǎnfèi de lǚyóu hé jiànjiǎn.","english":"Modern enterprises increasingly value employee benefits and health, for example, providing free travel and health checkups."}]

[{"chinese":"父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。","pinyin":"Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.","english":"The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me."}]

[{"chinese":"儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。","pinyin":"Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.","english":"Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me."}]

[{"chinese":"我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。","pinyin":"Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.","english":"My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean."}]

items.meaning: wood (M: 根 gēn, 塊 kuài)
items.simple: wood (M: 根 gēn, 塊 kuài)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。","pinyin":"Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.","english":"I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react."}]

[{"chinese":"你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。","pinyin":"Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.","english":"When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted."}]

items.meaning: to take into account or consideration
items.examples: [{"chinese":"那個店員只顧著玩手機，客人來了都不知道。","pinyin":"Nàge diànyuán zhǐ gùzhe wán shǒujī, kèrén lái le dōu bù zhīdào.","english":"That clerk only cared about playing on his phone; he didn't even notice when customers came."}]

[{"chinese":"A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。","pinyin":"A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.","english":"A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday."}]

[{"chinese":"這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。","pinyin":"Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.","english":"These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies."}]

[{"chinese":"「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。","pinyin":"「Zǒngtǒng」 shì guójiā zuìgāo lǐngdǎorén, tā lǐngdǎo quánguó mínzhòng wǎng qián zǒu, ràng guójiā yuè lái yuè jìnbù.","english":"The \"president\" is the highest leader of the country; he leads the people of the whole nation forward, making the country more and more progressive."}]

[{"chinese":"總統對國家的貢獻很大，全國民眾都很尊敬他。","pinyin":"Zǒngtǒng duì guójiā de gòngxiàn hěn dà, quánguó mínzhòng dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.","english":"The president's contribution to the country is great; the people of the whole nation all respect him."}]
[{"chinese":"有人說，這個世界是上帝創造的，你相信嗎？","pinyin":"Yǒurén shuō, zhège shìjiè shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de, nǐ xiāngxìn ma?","english":"Some people say that this world was created by God; do you believe it?"}]

items.meaning: to carry out, to put into practice
items.examples: [{"chinese":"這個改善空氣品質的計畫，已經實行三年了，還需要一段時間才能看到成果。","pinyin":"Zhège gǎishàn kōngqì pǐnzhí de jìhuà, yǐjīng shíxíng sān nián le, hái xūyào yī duàn shíjiān cái néng kàndào chéngguǒ.","english":"This plan to improve air quality has already been carried out for three years; it still needs some time before results can be seen."}]

[{"chinese":"這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。","pinyin":"Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng fēicháng hùnluàn, yóuqí shì chē duō rén duō de shàngxiàbān shíjiān.","english":"The traffic in this area is very chaotic, especially during rush hour when there are many cars and people."}]

[{"chinese":"李導演付出了十年的時間，終於拍出了一部好電影，得到大家的肯定。","pinyin":"Lǐ dǎoyǎn fùchū le shí nián de shíjiān, zhōngyú pāichū le yī bù hǎo diànyǐng, dédào dàjiā de kěndìng.","english":"Director Li devoted ten years of time and finally made a good movie, receiving everyone's recognition."}]

[{"chinese":"杜先生是三家網路商店的主管，他希望將來能當大企業的老闆，擁有自己的事業。","pinyin":"Dù xiānsheng shì sān jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn de zhǔguǎn, tā xīwàng jiānglái néng dāng dà qǐyè de lǎobǎn, yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de shìyè.","english":"Mr. Du is the manager of three online stores; he hopes that in the future he can become the boss of a big enterprise and have his own career."}]

[{"chinese":"學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。","pinyin":"Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.","english":"Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem."}]

[{"chinese":"小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。","pinyin":"Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.","english":"Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman."}]

[{"chinese":"小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。","pinyin":"Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.","english":"Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all."}]

[{"chinese":"太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。","pinyin":"Tàitai: Nǐ hē zuì le, bié zài hē le. Husband: Okay, okay, there's still one sip left; after I finish it, I won't drink anymore."}]

[{"chinese":"這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。","pinyin":"Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.","english":"In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved."}]

[{"chinese":"以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。","pinyin":"Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.","english":"Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs."}]

[{"chinese":"那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。","pinyin":"Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.","english":"The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police."}]

[{"chinese":"紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。","pinyin":"Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.","english":"Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph."}]

[{"chinese":"陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。","pinyin":"Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.","english":"Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to."}]

[{"chinese":"我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。","pinyin":"Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.","english":"Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat."}]

A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain."}]

[{"chinese":"自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。","pinyin":"Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.","english":"Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer."}]

[{"chinese":"明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。","pinyin":"Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.","english":"I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting."}]

[{"chinese":"方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。","pinyin":"Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.","english":"Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her."}]

[{"chinese":"有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。","pinyin":"Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.","english":"Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually."}]

items.meaning: to preview; to prepare lessons before class

items.meaning: to give a speech, to give a lecture, to perform

items.meaning: in those years, in those days

[{"chinese":"那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。","pinyin":"Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.","english":"That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture."}]

[{"chinese":"只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。","pinyin":"Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.","english":"As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news."}]

[{"chinese":"A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？","pinyin":"A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?"}]
[{"chinese":"溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。","pinyin":"Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.","english":"On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates."}]

[{"chinese":"老闆為了感謝員工為公司付出這麼多，決定親手做菜請大家吃。","pinyin":"Lǎobǎn wèile gǎnxiè yuángōng wèi gōngsī fùchū zhème duō, juédìng qīnshǒu zuò cài qǐng dàjiā chī.","english":"To thank the employees for contributing so much to the company, the boss decided to personally cook a meal and invite everyone to eat."}]

[{"chinese":"站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？","pinyin":"1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?","english":"1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?"}]

[{"chinese":"客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。","pinyin":"Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.","english":"The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it."}]

[{"chinese":"跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。","pinyin":"1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.","english":"1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you."}]

[{"chinese":"聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。","pinyin":"1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth."}]

[{"chinese":"華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。","pinyin":"Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.","english":"On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner."}]

items.meaning: couple; husband and wife (M: 對 duì)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。","pinyin":"1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas."}]

[{"chinese":"想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。","pinyin":"1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well."}]

[{"chinese":"警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。","pinyin":"Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.","english":"After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up."}]

[{"chinese":"媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。","pinyin":"Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.","english":"Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast."}]

[{"chinese":"如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？","pinyin":"Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?","english":"If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?"}]

[{"chinese":"外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。","pinyin":"1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.","english":"1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness."}]

[{"chinese":"張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。","pinyin":"Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.","english":"Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation."}]

items.meaning: the name for the first days of each month, or the first ten days of the Lunar New Year; the beginning
items.examples: [{"chinese":"每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。","pinyin":"1. Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān. 2. Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.","english":"1. The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year. 2. My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month."}]

[{"chinese":"這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。","pinyin":"Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.","english":"The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year."}]

[{"chinese":"他努力了三年，終於考上了最好的大學，他激動得流下了眼淚。","pinyin":"Tā nǔlì le sān nián, zhōngyú kǎoshàng le zuì hǎo de dàxué, tā jīdòng de liú xià le yǎnlèi.","english":"He worked hard for three years and finally got into the best university; he was so excited that he shed tears."}]

[{"chinese":"幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？","pinyin":"1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?"}]

[{"chinese":"人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。","pinyin":"Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.","english":"A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy."}]

[{"chinese":"中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。","pinyin":"Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.","english":"The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family."}]

[{"chinese":"那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。","pinyin":"Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.","english":"That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination."}]

[{"chinese":"每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。","pinyin":"Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.","english":"Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten."}]

[{"chinese":"我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。","pinyin":"Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.","english":"We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise."}]

[{"chinese":"母親為家人親手織了幾件毛衣，希望讓大家過個溫暖的冬天。","pinyin":"Mǔqīn wèi jiārén qīnshǒu zhī le jǐ jiàn máoyī, xīwàng ràng dàjiā guò ge wēnnuǎn de dōngtiān.","english":"Mother personally knitted several sweaters for the family, hoping to let everyone have a warm winter."}]

[{"chinese":"這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。","pinyin":"Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.","english":"The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy."}]

[{"chinese":"在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。","pinyin":"Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.","english":"In the real world, there is no such animal as a \"dragon\"; that is only the imagination of ancient people."}]

[{"chinese":"我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。","pinyin":"Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.","english":"My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much."}]

[{"chinese":"總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。","pinyin":"Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.","english":"When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests."}]

[{"chinese":"付完學費，我的獎學金只剩下三千塊，這個月只有吃饅頭過日子了。","pinyin":"Fù wán xuéfèi, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn zhǐ shèng xià sānqiān kuài, zhège yuè zhǐyǒu chī mántou guò rìzi le.","english":"After paying the tuition, I only have 3000 dollars of my scholarship left; this month I can only live on steamed buns."}]

[{"chinese":"做好環境保護的工作，是每個現代人應盡的責任。","pinyin":"Zuò hǎo huánjìng bǎohù de gōngzuò, shì měi ge xiàndài rén yīng jìn de zérèn.","english":"Doing a good job in environmental protection is the responsibility that every modern person should fulfill."}]

[{"chinese":"我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。","pinyin":"Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.","english":"Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. [{"chinese":"天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。","pinyin":"Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.","english":"The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again."}]

[{"chinese":"A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。","pinyin":"A: Fàncuò de rén dōu kěyǐ qǐngqiú yuánliàng ma? B: Děi kàn tā fàn de shì shénme cuò, yàoshi xiǎoxiǎo de cuò, jiù gāi yuánliàng ba.","english":"A: Can everyone who makes a mistake ask for forgiveness? B: It depends on what mistake he made; if it's a small mistake, then he should be forgiven."}]

[{"chinese":"A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。","pinyin":"A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne?
