B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her."}]

[{"chinese":"天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。","pinyin":"Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.","english":"There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way."}]

[{"chinese":"小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。","pinyin":"Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.","english":"Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture."}]

[{"chinese":"易先生對戲劇有很大的興趣，小時候的夢想就是當一名成功的演員。","pinyin":"Yì xiānsheng duì xìjù yǒu hěn dà de xìngqù, xiǎoshíhou de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng chénggōng de yǎnyuán.","english":"Mr. Yi has a great interest in drama; his childhood dream was to become a successful actor."}]

[{"chinese":"如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。","pinyin":"Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.","english":"If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods."}]

[{"chinese":"顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。","pinyin":"Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.","english":"Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular."}]
[{"chinese":"這座古蹟已經有兩百多年的歷史。","pinyin":"Zhè zuò gǔjì yǐjīng yǒu liǎngbǎi duō nián de lìshǐ.","english":"This ancient relic already has a history of more than two hundred years."}]

[{"chinese":"這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。","pinyin":"Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.","english":"The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend."}]

[{"chinese":"《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。","pinyin":"《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.","english":"\"Happy Birthday\" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages."}]

[{"chinese":"這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。","pinyin":"Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì yīnwèi gōnggòng shèbèi tài jiù, gòuwù yě bù fāngbiàn, bùshǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le.","english":"Because this ancient city's public facilities are too old and shopping is also inconvenient, quite a few people have moved away."}]

[{"chinese":"學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。","pinyin":"Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.","english":"The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure."}]

[{"chinese":"這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。","pinyin":"1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.","english":"1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him."}]

[{"chinese":"國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。","pinyin":"Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.","english":"Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility."}]

[{"chinese":"康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！","pinyin":"Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!","english":"Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!"}]

[{"chinese":"這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。","pinyin":"Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.","english":"Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live."}]

[{"chinese":"那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。","pinyin":"Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn shífēn shēngdòng, huà lǐ de rénwù hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chūlái yīyàng.","english":"That painter's works are extremely vivid; the figures in the paintings seem as if they could really walk out of the paintings."}]

[{"chinese":"夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。","pinyin":"Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.","english":"On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven."}]

[{"chinese":"有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。","pinyin":"Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.","english":"Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing."}]

items.meaning: a period extending from some time in the past until now
items.examples: [{"chinese":"張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。","pinyin":"Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.","english":"Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good."}]

[{"chinese":"一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。","pinyin":"Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.","english":"Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple."}]

[{"chinese":"那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。","pinyin":"Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.","english":"Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in."}]

[{"chinese":"不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。","pinyin":"Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.","english":"Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance."}]

[{"chinese":"每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。","pinyin":"Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.","english":"Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history."}]

[{"chinese":"孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。","pinyin":"Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.","english":"Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words."}]

items.meaning: to realize; to learn from experience
items.examples: [{"chinese":"姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。","pinyin":"Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.","english":"Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard."}]

[{"chinese":"在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。","pinyin":"Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, \"lóng\" jùyǒu zhòngyào de wénhuà yìyì, dàn \"lóng\" qíshí shì bù cúnzài de.","english":"In Chinese society, the \"dragon\" has important cultural significance, but the \"dragon\" actually does not exist."}]

[{"chinese":"博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。","pinyin":"1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.","english":"1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests."}]

items.meaning: land (M: 塊 kuài, 片 piàn)
items.examples: [{"chinese":"我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。","pinyin":"Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.","english":"My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it."}]
items.simple: land (M: 塊 kuài, 片 piàn)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"小偷：我又沒偷東西，為什麼抓我？ 警察：你先別動，只要看了商店攝影機錄下來的內容，就知道事實了。","pinyin":"Xiǎotōu: Wǒ yòu méi tōu dōngxi, wèishénme zhuā wǒ? Jǐngchá: Nǐ xiān bié dòng, zhǐyào kàn le shāngdiàn shèyǐngjī lù xiàlái de nèiróng, jiù zhīdào shìshí le.","english":"Thief: I didn't steal anything, why are you arresting me? Police: Don't move first; as long as you look at what the store's camera recorded, you'll know the fact."}]

[{"chinese":"王老先生年輕時就離開了家鄉，他很想回老家去看看親人。","pinyin":"Wáng lǎoxiānsheng niánqīng shí jiù líkāi le jiāxiāng, tā hěn xiǎng huí lǎojiā qù kànkan qīnrén.","english":"Mr. Wang left his hometown when he was young; he really wants to go back to his old home to see his relatives."}]

[{"chinese":"上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。","pinyin":"Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.","english":"Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued."}]

[{"chinese":"A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。","pinyin":"A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.","english":"A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true."}]

[{"chinese":"臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。","pinyin":"1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.","english":"1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say."}]

[{"chinese":"我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。","pinyin":"Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.","english":"I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report."}]

[{"chinese":"人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。","pinyin":"Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.","english":"Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation."}]

[{"chinese":"王教授有一本古書，那本書已經有幾百年的歷史了。","pinyin":"Wáng jiàoshòu yǒu yī běn gǔ shū, nà běn shū yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.","english":"Professor Wang has an old book; that book already has several hundred years of history."}]

[{"chinese":"有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。","pinyin":"Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.","english":"Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct."}]

[{"chinese":"這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。","pinyin":"Zhè běn shū yǒu fēngfù de nèiróng jí shēngdòng de qiānbǐhuà, shì xīyǐn dúzhě gòumǎi de zhǔyào yuányīn.","english":"This book has rich content and lively pencil drawings, which are the main reasons that attract readers to buy it."}]

[{"chinese":"絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。","pinyin":"Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.","english":"The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done."}]

[{"chinese":"看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。","pinyin":"Kàn diànyǐng shí, rúguǒ yào zhànshí líkāi zuòwèi, jìde bǎ zhòngyào wùpǐn dài zài shēnshang.","english":"When watching a movie, if you need to temporarily leave your seat, remember to carry your important belongings with you."}]

items.meaning: picture, illustration (M: 張 zhāng, 幅 fú)
items.examples: [{"chinese":"只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。","pinyin":"Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.","english":"Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking."}]
items.simple: picture (M: 張 zhāng, 幅 fú)

items.examples: [{"chinese":"今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。","pinyin":"Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.","english":"This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal."}]

[{"chinese":"這是我和你之間的祕密，你絕對不可告訴別人。","pinyin":"Zhè shì wǒ hé nǐ zhījiān de mìmì, nǐ juéduì bùkě gàosu biérén.","english":"This is a secret between you and me; you absolutely must not tell anyone else."}]

[{"chinese":"要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。","pinyin":"Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.","english":"To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise."}]

[{"chinese":"爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。","pinyin":"Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.","english":"Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either."}]

[{"chinese":"古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。","pinyin":"Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.","english":"Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out."}]

[{"chinese":"因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.","english":"Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being."}]

[{"chinese":"他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。","pinyin":"Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.","english":"In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment."}]

[{"chinese":"想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。","pinyin":"Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.","english":"If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day."}]

[{"chinese":"為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。","pinyin":"Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.","english":"In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete."}]

[{"chinese":"這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。","pinyin":"Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.","english":"Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition."}]

[{"chinese":"因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.","english":"Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker."}]

[{"chinese":"(1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。","pinyin":"Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.","english":"Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more."}]

[{"chinese":"A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。","pinyin":"A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.","english":"A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings."}]

[{"chinese":"這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。","pinyin":"Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.","english":"I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us."}]

[{"chinese":"這個世界拼圖很難拼，得花好幾天才拼得成。","pinyin":"Zhè ge shìjiè pīntú hěn nán pīn, děi huā hǎo jǐ tiān cái pīn de chéng.","english":"This world puzzle is very difficult to piece together; it will take several days to piece it together successfully."}]

[{"chinese":"林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。","pinyin":"Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.","english":"Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them."}]

[{"chinese":"這本小說介紹了許多中國的古人古事，內容既豐富又有趣。","pinyin":"Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jièshào le xǔduō Zhōngguó de gǔrén gǔshì, nèiróng jì fēngfù yòu yǒuqù.","english":"This novel introduces many stories of ancient Chinese people and events; its content is both rich and interesting."}]

[{"chinese":"哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。","pinyin":"Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.","english":"My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family."}]

[{"chinese":"到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。","pinyin":"Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.","english":"The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal."}]

[{"chinese":"小安有一張娃娃臉，到哪裡都被當作大學生，誰知道他已經四十歲了。","pinyin":"Xiǎo'ān yǒu yì zhāng wáwa liǎn, dào nǎlǐ dōu bèi dàngzuò dàxuéshēng, shéi zhīdào tā yǐjīng sìshí suì le.","english":"Xiao An has a baby face, so wherever he goes he is treated as a university student; who would know he is already forty years old."}]

[{"chinese":"誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。","pinyin":"Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.","english":"No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself."}]

[{"chinese":"小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。","pinyin":"Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.","english":"Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together."}]

[{"chinese":"根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。","pinyin":"Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.","english":"According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day."}]

[{"chinese":"歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。","pinyin":"Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.","english":"Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials."}]

[{"chinese":"從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。","pinyin":"Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.","english":"Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud."}]

[{"chinese":"有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。","pinyin":"Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.","english":"Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained."}]

[{"chinese":"最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。","pinyin":"Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.","english":"The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella."}]

[{"chinese":"上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。","pinyin":"Shàngdì shì bú shì cúnzài, zhè shì shǔyú zōngjiào lǐngyù de wèntí, kēxuéjiā de jiěshì bù yídìng shì zhèngquè de.","english":"Whether God exists or not is a question that belongs to the religious field; scientists' explanations are not necessarily correct."}]

[{"chinese":"昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。","pinyin":"Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.","english":"Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue."}]

[{"chinese":"為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。","pinyin":"Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.","english":"In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans."}]

[{"chinese":"人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。","pinyin":"Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.","english":"Population growth not only affects the quality of life, but I am afraid it will also cause the problem of food shortage."}]

[{"chinese":"飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。","pinyin":"Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.","english":"Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time."}]

[{"chinese":"科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。","pinyin":"Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.","english":"Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world."}]

[{"chinese":"快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。","pinyin":"Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.","english":"The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices."}]

[{"chinese":"科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。","pinyin":"Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.","english":"Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution."}]

[{"chinese":"想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。","pinyin":"Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.","english":"If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit."}]

[{"chinese":"那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。","pinyin":"Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.","english":"That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel."}]

[{"chinese":"因為冰箱壞了，裡面的食物除了雞蛋、蘋果，其他的都腐敗了。","pinyin":"Yīnwèi bīngxiāng huài le, lǐmiàn de shíwù chúle jīdàn, píngguǒ, qítā de dōu fǔbài le.","english":"Because the refrigerator broke, the food inside, except for the eggs and apples, all rotted."}]

[{"chinese":"這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。","pinyin":"Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.","english":"This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt."}]

[{"chinese":"王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。","pinyin":"Wáng bóbo zuìjìn hěn déyì, dàochù gàosù línjū tā érzi kǎo shàng le quánguó zuì yǒumíng de dàxué.","english":"Uncle Wang has been very proud of himself recently, telling neighbors everywhere that his son has been admitted to the most famous university in the country."}]

[{"chinese":"使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。","pinyin":"Shǐyòng dìqiú zīyuán hé bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì xiāngduì de, zīyuán shǐyòng de yuè duō, huánjìng jiù yuè xūyào bèi bǎohù.","english":"Using Earth's resources and protecting Earth's environment are relative: the more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected."}]

[{"chinese":"路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。","pinyin":"Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.","english":"The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him."}]

[{"chinese":"王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。","pinyin":"Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.","english":"Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year."}]

[{"chinese":"當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。","pinyin":"Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.","english":"When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved."}]

[{"chinese":"像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。","pinyin":"Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.","english":"This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need."}]

[{"chinese":"儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。","pinyin":"Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.","english":"Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement."}]

[{"chinese":"由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。","pinyin":"Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.","english":"Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past."}]

[{"chinese":"連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。","pinyin":"Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.","english":"Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it."}]

[{"chinese":"對某一些人來說，結了婚還能不能有其他情人，這是道德問題。","pinyin":"Duì mǒu yīxiē rén lái shuō, jié le hūn hái néng bù néng yǒu qítā qíngrén, zhè shì dàodé wèntí.","english":"For some people, whether one can still have other lovers after getting married is a moral issue."}]

[{"chinese":"由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。","pinyin":"Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.","english":"Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty."}]

items.meaning: for nothing, to no purpose; in vain
items.examples: [{"chinese":"每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。","pinyin":"Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.","english":"Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour."}]

[{"chinese":"打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。","pinyin":"Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.","english":"Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee."}]

[{"chinese":"經過服務人員詳細地說明，使得客人對公司的產品更了解了。","pinyin":"Jīngguò fúwù rényuán xiángxì de shuōmíng, shǐde kèrén duì gōngsī de chǎnpǐn gèng liǎojiě le.","english":"After the service staff's detailed explanation, it made the customers understand the company's products better."}]

[{"chinese":"大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。","pinyin":"Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.","english":"Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs."}]

[{"chinese":"中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。","pinyin":"Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.","english":"There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods."}]

[{"chinese":"元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。","pinyin":"Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.","english":"During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful."}]

[{"chinese":"夏天時，在臺灣、日本、菲律賓都有颱風，這是很普遍的現象。","pinyin":"Xiàtiān shí, zài Táiwān, Rìběn, Fēilǜbīn dōu yǒu táifēng, zhè shì hěn pǔbiàn de xiànxiàng.","english":"In summer, there are typhoons in Taiwan, Japan, and the Philippines; this is a very common phenomenon."}]

[{"chinese":"到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。","pinyin":"Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.","english":"Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different."}]

[{"chinese":"這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。","pinyin":"Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.","english":"These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines."}]

[{"chinese":"理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。","pinyin":"Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.","english":"In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research."}]

[{"chinese":"許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。","pinyin":"Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.","english":"Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued."}]

[{"chinese":"在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。","pinyin":"Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.","english":"In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet."}]

[{"chinese":"今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。","pinyin":"Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.","english":"Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied."}]

items.meaning: in any case, by all possible means
items.examples: [{"chinese":"照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。","pinyin":"Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.","english":"Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them."}]

[{"chinese":"大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。","pinyin":"Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.","english":"Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date."}]
